product_name: Print Detective: Letters, Words & First Sounds

teaching_steps.title: Sort
teaching_steps.detail: Levels 1-2: student sorts each card and says the rule aloud.

teaching_steps.title: Match
teaching_steps.detail: Level 3: say the picture name, stretch the first sound, place it under the letter.

teaching_steps.title: Track
teaching_steps.detail: Level 4: follow the arrow, touch each word, find word boundaries.

teaching_steps.title: Check
teaching_steps.detail: Use the answer key; record accuracy on the IEP monitoring form.
